parsed.seniority_signal: 3+ years of experience leading Machine Learning research initiatives.
parsed.degree_signal: PhD in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field.
parsed.notes:
Required Qualifications sets required labels; Preferred/Bonus Qualifications sets nice_to_have labels.
Seniority follows the explicit research-leadership experience, rather than the years alone.
Cloud providers and container/orchestration tools are grouped as examples offered for their respective asks; LLMs and VLMs are joined by 'and' and are not grouped.
Taking the qualifications literally, generic model optimization is not necessarily inference optimization, and generic ML frameworks are not necessarily deep-learning frameworks; these remain unmapped.
Generative models is broader than LLMs and has no exact taxonomy entry.
Technologies and practices appearing only in responsibilities or company descriptions are excluded.
